perch.description: One timeline of what the posting bot will send tonight and after, every group merged, out as far as the queues last.
perch.empty: Nothing to show. Point Perch at the bot's folder and press Refresh.
perch.error.nobot: Could not find the posting bot. Pick its folder.
perch.howitworks: Nothing here is new. The bot's own rules for order, rate, offset, jitter and stretching are run forward from the queues as they are now. It is a projection, not a promise: a paused bot, a file it refuses or anything added to a queue changes the picture.
perch.projection.note: Interval groups fire on a clock that starts with the bot, which this machine cannot see. Type when it was started, or leave it empty for how things would run from now.
perch.slot.dry: The queue is empty from here. The bot starts repeating the archive.
perch.slot.nothing: Nothing in the queue and nothing in the archive. This group posts nothing.
perch.slot.random: A random pick from the queue, decided at post time.
perch.started.now.hint: As if the bot were started this minute. Right whenever it is about to be restarted.
perch.started.unreadable: That is not a time this can read. Try 2026-09-13 21:00, or 21:00 for today.
perch.started.why: Interval groups count from when the bot was started. Daily groups do not care.
perch.status.dry: {0} posts in view, and {1} group(s) run dry inside them.
